extract_waymo_pointcloud: extract lidar point cloud data from Waymo Open Dataset TFRecord segments and save as numpy arrays per frame
convert_pc_to_obj: convert a numpy point cloud array to an OBJ file format for 3D visualization
parse_range_images: parse range images and camera projections from a Waymo dataset frame using frame_utils
extract_camera_intrinsics: extract camera intrinsic parameters including focal length, principal point, and distortion coefficients from Waymo frames
save_datalist: save a list of extracted point cloud file paths as a numpy array for downstream processing
